_comment: Hand-entered run years for series whose provider gives no dates.
MangaPill lists chapters with no publication date at all, so every manga
series arrived with a start year guessed from its slug and no end year —
which made finished runs like Jujutsu Kaisen and JoJolion look like they are
still going, and stretched them across every year of the chronology board.
end_year null means genuinely still running. Volume is low enough to keep
this by hand; scripts/apply_series_run_years.py writes it into the database.

berserk-1989.note: Continued by Studio Gaga after Miura's death in 2021.

vinland-saga-2005.note: Ended with chapter 220 on 2025-07-25 after 20 years.
